title: Command
description: What a backend accepts, from the user's side. Every command has type and thread_id.

Command.description: A command, told apart by type.

SendCommand.description: Send the agent a message. It starts a turn if none is running, and steers the running one if one is.

client_id.description: The client's own id for the message, copied to the user_message item.

InterruptCommand.description: Stop the running turn. Does nothing if none is running.

SetOptionsCommand.description: Change the thread's options. Fields left out stay as they are. They apply from the next turn, or straight away where the harness allows.

RewindCommand.description: Take the conversation back to before a turn: the harness forgets that turn and every one after it, and their items are removed from the thread. Refused while a turn is running.

turn_id.description: The turn to go back to before (a turn_id of the thread's items).

NewSessionCommand.description: Start a new conversation with the harness at the next turn, in the same thread: its session_id is cleared, so the agent doesn't remember the turns before. The items stay. Refused while a turn is running.

CompactCommand.description: Compact the harness's context now: a turn of its own, with no user_message, that adds a compaction item. Refused while a turn is running, or when the thread has no session yet.
